command: cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com | head -c 1500; echo; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | head -c 3000; which mcpjam npx; env | grep -c MCPJAM
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE "cli|eval|api" | cut -c1-200; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/getting-started.md | head -60
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md | head -120; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md | head -150

cd /workspace; export PATH=$PATH:.; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $M server probe --url http://fixture:8765/mcp 2>&1 | head -30; $M tools list --url http://fixture:8765/mcp 2>&1 | head -60; $M cloud status 2>&1 | head -20

cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $M tools call --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":2,"b":3}' 2>&1 | head -c 600; echo; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md | grep -n -A40 -i "cloud eval commands" | head -110
cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $M cloud eval --help 2>&1 | head -30; $M cloud eval create --help 2>&1 | head -40; $M cloud projects --help 2>&1 | head -20

cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest --quiet"; $M cloud projects servers list --project project_fixture 2>&1 | head -c 1200; echo; $M cloud eval list --project project_fixture 2>&1 | head -c 800; echo; $M cloud projects servers connect --help | head -30

cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest --quiet"; $M cloud projects servers connect --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --project project_fixture --name arithmetic --no-browser 2>&1 | head -c 1000; echo; $M cloud projects servers --project project_fixture 2>&1 | head -c 600; $M cloud projects servers list --project project_fixture 2>&1 | head -c 800

cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest --quiet"; $M cloud eval run --help | head -40; $M cloud eval create --project project_fixture --server Arithmetic --name "Arithmetic add" --json '{"tests":[{"title":"add 2 and 3","query":"Use the add tool to add 2 and 3 and report the sum.","runs":1,"expectedToolCalls":[{"toolName":"add","arguments":{"a":2,"b":3}}]}]}' 2>&1 | head -c 1500

cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest --quiet"; $M cloud eval create --project project_fixture --server Arithmetic --name "Arithmetic add" --model anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5 --json '{"cases":[{"title":"add 2 and 3","query":"Use the add tool to add 2 and 3 and report the sum.","runs":1,"expectedToolCalls":[{"toolName":"add","arguments":{"a":2,"b":3}}]}]}' 2>&1 | head -c 1500

cd /workspace; cat > suite.json <<'E'
{"name":"Arithmetic add","model":"anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5","cases":[{"title":"add 2 and 3","steps":[{"kind":"prompt","prompt":"Use the add tool to add 2 and 3 and report the sum."},{"kind":"assert","assertion":{"type":"toolCalledAtLeastOnce","toolName":"add"}}]}]}
E
M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest --quiet"; $M cloud eval create --project project_fixture --server Arithmetic --file suite.json 2>&1 | head -c 1500

cd /workspace; cat > suite.json <<'E'
{"name":"Arithmetic add","model":"anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5","cases":[{"title":"add 2 and 3","steps":[{"id":"s1","kind":"prompt","prompt":"Use the add tool to add 2 and 3 and report the sum."},{"id":"a1","kind":"assert","assertion":{"type":"toolCalledAtLeastOnce","toolName":"add"}}]}]}
E
M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest --quiet"; $M cloud eval create --project project_fixture --server Arithmetic --file suite.json 2>&1 | head -c 1500

cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest --quiet"; $M cloud eval run --project project_fixture --suite suite_authored_1 --wait --reporter json-summary --out report.json 2>&1 | head -c 2000; echo; head -c 1500 report.json

cd /workspace; cat > suite.json <<'E'
{"name":"Arithmetic add deterministic","model":"anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5","cases":[{"title":"add 2 and 3","steps":[{"id":"s1","kind":"toolCall","toolName":"add","arguments":{"a":2,"b":3}},{"id":"a1","kind":"assert","assertion":{"type":"toolCalledAtLeastOnce","toolName":"add"}}]}]}
E
M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest --quiet"; $M cloud eval create --project project_fixture --server Arithmetic --file suite.json 2>&1 | head -c 800; echo; $M cloud eval run --project project_fixture --suite "Arithmetic add deterministic" --wait --reporter json-summary --out report.json 2>&1 | head -c 1500; echo; head -c 1500 report.json

cd /workspace; sed -i 's/"toolName":"add","arguments"/"serverName":"Arithmetic","toolName":"add","arguments"/' suite.json
M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest --quiet"; $M cloud eval create --project project_fixture --server Arithmetic --file suite.json 2>&1 | head -c 800; echo; $M cloud eval run --project project_fixture --suite "Arithmetic add deterministic" --wait --reporter json-summary --out report.json 2>&1 | head -c 1500; echo; head -c 1500 report.json
